JSW Group Launches AMPSTAR Electric Commercial Vehicle Brand

JSW Group has launched AMPSTAR, its electric bus and truck brand under JSW Greentech Limited, entering the commercial vehicle manufacturing sector. The company aims to build a capacity of 100,000 electric commercial vehicles by 2030. JSW Chairman Sajjan Jindal is investing approximately ₹2,000 crore in this venture. The first AMPSTAR vehicles are slated to go on sale within weeks.
